Shijiazhuang Henryte Chemicals Co., LTD. is a professional chemical enterprise based at No. 166 Yuhua Road (West), Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province, China. Positioned in one of North China’s key industrial hubs, the company leverages the region’s established supply chains and logistics corridors to serve customers efficiently across China and international markets. From its base in Shijiazhuang—well connected by highway and rail and with convenient access to Tianjin Port—Henryte focuses on reliable sourcing, production coordination, and distribution of industrial and specialty chemicals.

The company’s portfolio typically supports a wide range of downstream sectors, including pharmaceuticals and intermediates, agrochemical formulations, coatings and pigments, water treatment, cleaning and personal care ingredients, and general manufacturing. Emphasis is placed on consistent quality, traceable documentation, and responsive technical support. Henryte works closely with vetted producers and testing laboratories to align deliveries with customers’ specifications, offering options for customized grades, tailored packaging, and flexible order volumes from pilot-scale to bulk shipments.

Operationally, Henryte emphasizes safety, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance. The team follows rigorous quality management practices, maintains clear material handling and labeling protocols, and keeps abreast of applicable international standards to support smooth market access. Dedicated export and customer-service staff provide prompt quotations, sample coordination where feasible, and end-to-end logistics planning, including multimodal transport and timely customs documentation.

With a service-driven approach and a commitment to long-term partnerships, Shijiazhuang Henryte Chemicals Co., LTD. aims to deliver dependable products, practical solutions, and professional communication to clients in China and abroad. Inquiries are welcome for product lists, technical data, and collaborative development of tailored chemical solutions.
